description: This file defines a utility namespace 'Utils' with a class 'IARM' that provides static methods for initializing and checking the connection status of an IARM bus, along with related macros and includes.

classes.name: Utils::IARM
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to initialize and verify connection status of the IARM bus.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the IARM bus connection, attempting retries if necessary.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the IARM bus is currently connected.
